notes.title: More playtesting!
notes.content: [p]Hello, my lovely farmers![/p][p]First of all – [b]THANK YOU SO MUCH FOR PLAYING!![/b][/p][p]When I launched this playtest, I wasn’t expecting so many of you to join. I’m incredibly grateful and more excited than ever to keep working on Cropdeck![/p][p][/p][h3][b]The playtest is staying open![/b][/h3][p]Originally, the plan was to share an early build, gather feedback, and then close the doors to keep working quietly. But with so much interest and support, I’ve decided to keep the playtest open a while longer! [b]I don’t have a set end date yet, but you can keep playing for at least another week.[/b] Especially because…[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Rebalance Patch v0.1.4 is live![/b][/h3][p]While a lot of you enjoyed the game, many also pointed out areas where it needed tuning, especially the difficulty curve.[/p][p]This new patch focuses on balance:[/p][list][*][p]Gameplay should feel more even and less frustrating.[/p][/*][*][p]There are [b]two new scarecrows[/b] to discover![/p][/*][*][p]Weather difficulty now scales better over time.[/p][/*][*][p]Early levels are easier, and late ones are more challenging.[/p][/*][/list][p]Read the full patch notes for all the juicy details! I’d love to hear what you think.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3826600/view/515216422280888689"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45491863/a48cbb1087f4bfd70369696f14841c6e6499695c.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]First week stats and your amazing feedback![/b][/h3][quote][p]“Absolutely LOVED the game! Surprised me in a lot of ways.”[/p][p]“I really enjoyed the game and can't wait to see where it goes!”[/p][p]“Great game. Relaxing, and one-of-a-kind :D”[/p][/quote][p]You’ve shared [b]over 200 feedback surveys[/b], filled with great ideas, helpful critiques, and lots of kind words. It truly means a lot![/p][p]Here’s what the first week looked like in numbers:[/p][list][*][p]🕒 [b]Average playtime[/b]: 1h 49min[/p][/*][*][p]🕒 [b]Median playtime[/b]: 1h 2min (this is HUGE!!)[/p][/*][*][p]🎮 [b]600+ players[/b] joined the game[/p][/*][*][p]🧾 Almost [b]1000 sign-ups[/b] total[/p][/*][*][p]💚 [b]850+ wishlists[/b][/p][/*][*][p]📝 [b]200+ feedback forms submitted[/b][/p][/*][*][p]💬 [b]30 new folks[/b] [b][url="https://discord.gg/6sB9zeUCph"]joined the Discord[/url][/b][url="https://discord.gg/6sB9zeUCph"] (you can too!)[/url][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you for playing, testing, sharing, and supporting this little farming deckbuilder. I'm back to the fields (and the code), working on even more improvements. Let's grow something great together![/p][p]Best,[/p][p][b]– Piotrek[/b][/p]

notes.title: Cropdeck Playtest is now live – jump in and play!
notes.content: [p]The time has finally come! After over 8 months of development, I'm excited to show you what I’ve been working on. You can now download the [b]Cropdeck Playtest[/b] and harvest all the carrots! If you haven’t signed up yet, don’t worry! Just head over to the store page and join the playtest now.[/p][p]The playtest is available on [b]Windows, macOS, Linux, and Steam Deck[/b] – and yes, [b]gamepad support is included[/b]! The planned duration is one week (until July 24th), but this may change.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]How to start?[/b][/h3][p]The best way to begin your Cropdeck journey is by completing the short tutorial. You’ll learn the basics and meet the ever-charming [b]Sir Landlord[/b], who will gladly show you what it means to be a humble farmer on his precious land.[/p][p]Want more help? A few great playthroughs are already up on YouTube – a fun way to get a feel for the game![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45491863/3ea01bf11bc2f99b753a87fc0de0f59f027fa5f5.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]What’s in the playtest?[/b][/h3][p]Discover different cards, find powerful synergies, and explore various strategies. The playtest includes:[/p][list][*][p]🌱 [b]18 unique cards[/b] (with [b]43 total variations[/b])[/p][/*][*][p]🎃 [b]18 scarecrows[/b] with powerful passive effects[/p][/*][*][p]🌾 [b]3 biomes[/b] to challenge your farming skills[/p][/*][/list][p]All wrapped in a charming, slightly chaotic farming roguelite experience![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45491863/572aae64fb5ac0ddf43321fcac0dae3792da5b40.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]A word from the developer[/b][/h3][p]It’s amazing to let you play my game finally – making games is tough, but sharing them is the best part. This is still a [b]playtest[/b], so if you encounter bugs, balancing issues, or anything unclear, I’d love to hear from you![/p][p]There’s a [b]feedback survey[/b] and [b]bug report form[/b] in the main menu – feel free to use them anytime. You can also [b][url="https://discord.gg/6sB9zeUCph"]hop onto my Discord server[/url][/b] and share your thoughts, builds, or screenshots. I’ll be reading everything![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45491863/1f21723c2f3677324e4aaca4738c91b4b79098bc.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for being here, and have fun growing your deck![/p][p][b]– Piotrek[/b][/p]

notes.title: Cropdeck Playtest begins July 17th! Sign-ups are open!
notes.content: [p]Hello, dear farmers![/p][p]I’m excited to announce that [b]Cropdeck will soon have its first public build ready for you to try[/b]. You can request access now and start playing on [b]July 17th, Thursday[/b] – mark your calendars![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45491863/0a2d5c7f087cff0581e196e7d3dfb3246d32230f.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]What to expect?[/h3][p]The playtest offers a small but juicy slice of what’s planned for the full game. You’ll get about [b]2 hours of gameplay[/b], with each successful run taking around [b]30–45 minutes[/b] (or 20, if you speed run!).[/p][p]Here’s a taste of what’s included:[/p][list][*][p]18 unique scarecrows 🎃[/p][/*][*][p]18 cards with 43 total variations 🃏[/p][/*][*][p]11 plant types 🥕[/p][/*][*][p]3 biomes 🌍[/p][/*][*][p]1 glorious Sir Landlord 🎩[/p][/*][/list][p]Cropdeck will be playable on [b]Windows, macOS, Linux and Steam Deck[/b] – yes, controller support included![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45491863/7b93666b86c6a15b5e0cf42d9eadf1339f9f35ef.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]What’s the goal of the playtest?[/h3][p]The main goal is simple: [b]get your feedback[/b]![/p][p]This early version is a great opportunity to collect your impressions before the full demo goes live. I’m hoping to discover bugs, of course – but even more importantly, I want to learn what’s working, what’s not, and where the game can grow.[/p][p][b]Save the date – July 17th[/b], we are all plowing, watering, and planting.[/p][p][/p][h2][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3500680/Cropdeck/"][b]Request access now on the game's Steam Page![/b][/url][/h2][p][/p][p]You can also follow my socials and [url="https://discord.gg/VDMqueTP"][b]join the official Discord server[/b][/url], so as not to miss anything.[/p]

notes.title: How Cropdeck did on announcement (and some progress update)
notes.content:
First, [b]a huge thank you to everyone who has wishlisted or shared my game![/b] It has been an incredible two weeks since the Steam page launch, and I truly appreciate all your support.

[h1]🚜 First 291 Wishlists![/h1]
It may seem like an odd number (well, it literally is!), but 291 is how many gamers have wishlisted Cropdeck in its first two weeks on Steam! I’m so happy that you're interested in my game! This is my first solo project, and every wishlist, like, and comment means the world to me. 🙏

[h1]🌙 Steam Festival[/h1]
I’m excited to announce that Cropdeck is part of [b]The Days of Ramadan Festival 2025 on Steam[/b]! There are so many amazing new and upcoming games from Southeast Asia and beyond—including mine!

If you love cozy games and deckbuilders like me, you’ll find plenty of wonderful creations to explore. There are a lot of other categories too. Go check them out!

This is my first-ever Steam festival, and I’m sorry there’s no demo yet—but please be patient! I’m working hard to release the first playable demo in the coming months. If you don’t want to miss it, follow me on [url=https://bsky.app/profile/madheadbump.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url], [url=https://x.com/MadHeadBump]X[/url], or [url=https://www.threads.net/@mad.head.bump]Threads[/url] for updates.

[h1]🎨 Back to Work!![/h1]
The last two months were super busy for me, so I couldn’t focus as much on the game itself. Between setting up my Steam developer account, preparing the Steam page and marketing materials, taking a short holiday, going on a mountain trip, [b]aaand fighting the flu[/b] ([i]I’m all good now![/i])—a lot was happening.

[b]But now, I’m back and fully committed to Cropdeck![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45491863/a65cd8f76b4ce6d2e6c2aa7c89fbe60b60a5b3ed.gif[/img]

I’ve [b]started by updating the UI[/b], especially [b]the calendar and card feel[/b]. Scarecrows are now displayed above the fields, making them more visible and better connected to the game world. You can clearly see their effects now, and along with regular cards, they feel more alive thanks to subtle animations and mouse pointer interactions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45491863/a067170d1e44181b68af618a1f54d09f4fade997.gif[/img]

The calendar has been completely reworked. It used to be a large widget that didn’t provide much useful info. Now, [b]it works more like a progress bar[/b], similar to those in other roguelike games. It sits at the top of the screen, giving you hints about upcoming events and weather conditions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45491863/9d0b3507863c7d686f318d0beacf97f291874c81.gif[/img]

Speaking of weather... [b]I’ve started working on the weather system![/b] You’ll soon be able to plan your watering better by checking if rain is coming. Natural hazards (like the storms and ice cubes you saw in the trailer) will be part of this system too.

[h1]🎥 Follow Me on YouTube[/h1]
[b]Thank you so much for taking the time to read this post! [/b]If you’d like to stay updated, I’d love for you to follow me on socials. Today, I especially invite you to subscribe me on [url=https://www.youtube.com/@madheadbump]YouTube[/url], as I’m preparing some new Shorts content in new format!

notes.title: I Made It to Steam!
notes.content:
[h1]Dear farmers and roguelite enthusiasts, welcome![/h1]

Hi, I’m Piotrek! For the past few months, I’ve been hard at work on my first solo game. Today is the day my project finally sees the light of day. With pride and excitement, I present to you [b]Cropdeck![/b]

In this [b]farming roguelite deckbuilder[/b], you’ll take on the tough challenge of [b]crafting the ultimate deck of crops[/b], growing and nurturing them to achieve success, grow your wealth and… pay rent to Sir Landlord? A farmer’s work is never done! You’ll [b]collect a variety of cards, explore multiple worlds with unique mechanics[/b] and rely on [b]special cards - Scarecrows[/b]! Use their powerful abilities and passives to take your farming to the next level.

Intrigued? I invite you to check out the official [b]game announcement trailer[/b]. I hope you’ll love it!

[previewyoutube=rCH7R9HSamQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Plans for the Future[/h1]

I’m beyond excited to finally share the beginning of my game’s journey. Despite the effort and time I’ve already invested, this is just the start of the story. There’s still plenty to do before the project is complete. My goal is to deliver not just a polished product, but a game that will bring you hours of fun and creative gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45491863/77caa3e0b0c99059769f7d2198b1d5499e03c940.gif[/img]

Without giving away too much, here’s what you can expect in the future:
[list]
[*] Dozens of unique Scarecrows, each offering synergies I can’t wait for you to discover.
[*] A wide variety of crops that allow you to experiment and adapt your strategy to the challenges of each level.
[*] Challenging hazards that will test your strategy and keep the gameplay engaging.
[*] Full Steam Deck and controller support, so you can play however and wherever you like.
[/list]
In the coming weeks, I’ll share more details about Cropdeck and its mechanics. For now, I encourage you to [b]wishlist and follow the game[/b] on Steam.

If you’d like to stay updated on the game’s development, be sure to also follow me on social media. Let’s start with [url=https://bsky.app/profile/madheadbump.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url], shall we? :)

[b]Thank you for your interest in my project![/b]
